product_title: Handcrafted Pink Floral Pearl Jhumka Latkan Set
product_description: Add festive elegance to your home with these handcrafted latkans, featuring vibrant pink roses, decorative lotus flowers, golden beads, pearl accents, and intricate jhumka-style hangings. Perfect for doorways, curtains, pooja rooms, and festive decor.
product_care_suggestion: Dust gently with a soft, dry cloth.
Handle flowers and pearl tassels carefully.
Keep away from excessive moisture and direct sunlight.
Store in a dry box to prevent tangling and damage.
